name: IDBI Bank Limited
remarksWeb: The Bank has allotted 2387617322 equity shares to LIC on December 28, 2018, as a part (Tranche I) of the ongoing Acquisition of 51% controlling stake by LIC in IDBI Bank. In compliance of Regulation 22(2A) of the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, the said equity shares will be kept in a separate demat escrow account and the voting rights vis-a-vis the said equity shares shall not be exercised by LIC until the expiry of the open offer period.
